title: RedRays SAP Security Findings
descriptionMarkdown: Bring RedRays SAP security findings into Microsoft Sentinel. Review vulnerability assessments, ABAP code findings, BTP security, segregation of duties, profile parameter checks and password security in one workbook, with analytics rules for findings that need attention. RedRays sends data on a schedule you choose through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API and stays in your existing on-premises or cloud environment. This connector does not collect SAP Security Audit Log events or populate ABAPAuditLog. You need a RedRays license with Microsoft Sentinel integration. Azure ingestion and retention charges apply. This is a direct push integration; it does not deploy or use Azure Functions or a CCF polling connector.

sampleQueries.description: Latest export status by RedRays instance
sampleQueries.query: RedRaysExportHealth_CL | where RecordKind == 'HEARTBEAT' | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ProductInstanceId

value: RedRaysExportHealth_CL | where RecordKind == 'HEARTBEAT' | summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | project IsConnected=LastSeen > ago(2d)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and write permissions are required to configure the workspace tables.

customs.name: Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API
customs.description: The sending application requires the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role on the data collection rule (DCR). Workspace shared keys are not used.

customs.name: Azure resource deployment and role assignment
customs.description: Contributor access to the resource group and permission to assign the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role on the data collection rule (DCR), for example through Role Based Access Control Administrator.

customs.name: Microsoft Entra application
customs.description: An existing service principal and credential, or permission to create them.

customs.name: RedRays settings access
customs.description: Permission to configure the Microsoft Sentinel integration in RedRays.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Prepare your workspace and application
instructionSteps.description: Start with a Log Analytics workspace that has Microsoft Sentinel enabled in Azure public cloud. Create a dedicated Microsoft Entra application and client secret, or use an approved existing service principal. Keep the tenant ID, application (client) ID and service principal object ID handy. For the role assignment, use the service principal object ID from Enterprise applications; the application object ID and client ID are different values.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Deploy ingestion resources
instructionSteps.description: In RedRays, open Platform Settings > Microsoft Sentinel and download the deployment template. In Azure, open Deploy a custom template > Build your own template in the editor and upload it. Select your workspace's resource group and region, then enter workspaceName and senderPrincipalId. Leave deployAnalyticsRules=false; you will create rules from the Content Hub templates later. The deployment creates eight Analytics tables, a DCR for direct ingestion and a Monitoring Metrics Publisher role assignment scoped to that DCR. Copy ingestionEndpoint and dcrImmutableId from the deployment outputs. You can also use Deployment/azuredeploy.json from the source bundle. Check that your RedRays version uses the same eight table schemas as this solution, and give the DCR a dedicated name so it does not replace another integration's configuration.

instructionSteps.title: 3. Configure RedRays
instructionSteps.description: Enter tenant ID, client ID, client secret, ingestion endpoint and DCR immutable ID in RedRays. Choose the modules to export and how often to send data. Keep baseline alerting disabled for the first import, then save and enable the integration. RedRays needs outbound HTTPS access to Microsoft Entra and the Azure Monitor ingestion endpoint. No inbound connection is required.

instructionSteps.title: 4. Verify delivery
instructionSteps.description: Send a test event from RedRays, then wait for a scheduled export. Query RedRaysExportHealth_CL for RecordKind == 'HEARTBEAT'. A successful test means Azure accepted the request; the record may take time to appear in queries. The connector shows Connected when it has received a heartbeat in the past two days. Use the export health workbook to monitor delays against your export schedule.

instructionSteps.title: 5. Enable security content
instructionSteps.description: Open Manage solution to create the workbook and selected analytics rules from templates. Review the initial findings before enabling rules. Most finding rules alert on actionable High or Critical candidates. The profile rule raises Medium severity alerts for VULNERABLE checks. The workbook flags heartbeats older than 60 minutes; adjust the threshold above your export interval and expected ingestion delay. For operational notifications, configure an Azure Monitor log search alert separately. Disable equivalent rules from earlier RedRays deployments to avoid duplicate alerts. Delivery retries can still produce duplicate incidents, and finding updates do not automatically close incidents. For help, contact support@redrays.io.
